# One fresh W-FULL continuation at the repaired runtime

This source prepares a single continuation of the actual successful preparation run43785700341, attempt1. It restores that new subject and invokes the existing measured owner operation once, only after a separate exact owner grant. No old operation is replayed.

| Binding | Exact value |
|---|---|
| Qualified runtime | `6b353b48b2fc8a6de0c6223f48d341c484c98191` |
| Runtime tree | `92da6bf5f9d2d8d7ea723b56f2e99c838a9d984b` |
| Successful preparation source | `801889a5dada43c4c17d08939c330dd358e56e92` |
| Prepared operation SHA-256 | `8f76c756d7288bfb89f6e1b38d328d5db76ded21989e62fe5b34df1d06ded3b3` |
| Prepared operation bytes | 43,816 |
| Prepared controller | `dg18-w-full-43785700341-1` |
| Retained artifact | `14190058719` from run43785700341, attempt1 |
| Protected continuation branch | `engineering/pro-dg18-w-full-repaired-once-20261116` |
| Measurement limits | 60,000 ms; 201,326,592 bytes aggregate Job committed memory; zero baseline subtraction |

## Required exact authorization

The source is a proposal for a fresh protected operation. The old operation e0ac5d2992e44b45e838802c571fa84e27542aa72afab6ebb05c015e3207ec23 is consumed; its successful G0003 transition and failed memory qualification remain preserved. No old grant transfers.

Before execution, the owner must explicitly authorize one execution of the exact new operation8f76 and, for this new operation, retire the additional commission-only requirement for two concurrent DG16/DG17 owner originals. The original R0039 contract, genuine current resource noninterference, source/tool/subject currentness, independent receiving and complete process/memory accounting remain unchanged. The two-file continuation implements that proposed scope; until both elements are expressly approved, it must not be launched. No concurrence records are invented.

## Guarded continuation

Root publishes this reviewed source as a sole child of preparation801889a5. The protected branch is initially created dormant at this exact reviewed source, without either launch input. Only after the actual new owner grant and fresh noninterference receiving may Root create one sole-child commit adding exactly two100644 files: `OWNER_GRANT_REFERENCE.txt`, containing the real grant and its exact narrow retirement, and `EXPECTED_PREDECESSOR.txt`, naming the reviewed source commit.

The workflow requires a real noncreated/nondeleted/nonforced push, attempt1, exact before/after and sole-parent relationships, and exactly those two additions. The reviewed predecessor must itself be the direct child of801889a5, preventing a later linear push from re-arming it. No workflow or helper source may change in the authorized continuation. The preparation job does not match the protected branch. Creating the dormant branch is not an accepting execution.

The existing restorer receives pinned PREPARATION, OPERATION and SUBJECT.tar bytes; verifies all222 original tar members (156 files/66 directories;3,493,493 content bytes), safe paths/modes, exact tools, source snapshot and all retained refs/objects; and refuses an existing restoration root. It creates no claim, boundary or receipt. The unchanged maintained driver then executes the exact prepared operation under its original complete private-Job accounting. A separate always-capture retains actual post-attempt state on success or failure, without automatic retry, reset, compensation or cleanup.

Only the operation/run/artifact/source/population bindings and the explicitly proposed two-input grant scope differ from the existing reviewed continuation. The maintained Windows driver, checker and Job accounting remain unchanged. The old two-owner retirement is not silently extended by this source proposal.

N1 remains LOST/UNKNOWN and unconsumed. This operation supplies no authentic Stop event, OR observation/issuer grant, C02 adjudication/event/census, original prior/retry binding, amended cold-receiving population or whole-cell acceptance.
